long_biography.plain_text:
Raymond Gonzalez built his career around transport services that complement South Florida's public networks. At Transportation America, he served as president and chief executive while shaping systems for fleet maintenance, communications and record keeping. The company secured authority as a contract passenger carrier and became a major provider of paratransit and on-demand services for Miami-Dade County and local municipalities.

His wider operating platform reached beyond conventional passenger carriage. Limousines of South Florida ran fixed and flexible municipal routes across Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties, while MCT Express traded as Miami-Dade Ambulance and provided medical transportation. Gonzalez remains president of the active Florida corporations behind Transportation America and Limousines of South Florida, reflecting an owner-operator role sustained across several decades.
